items.text: Does the company publish clinical validation data for sensor accuracy (e.g., vs. gold standard)?
What is the reported accuracy rate (e.g., MARD) for key vital signs like heart rate or glucose?
Are there independent studies or certifications (e.g., FDA, CE) confirming sensor performance?
How many distinct wearable medical devices does the company offer (e.g., patches, watches, rings)?
Does the portfolio cover multiple therapeutic areas (e.g., cardiac, diabetes, respiratory)?
Are there devices for both consumer and clinical/professional use?
Does the company have peer-reviewed publications supporting clinical efficacy?
Are there ongoing or completed clinical trials for the wearable devices?
Does the company provide real-world evidence or outcomes data from patient use?
What is the average battery life of the company's wearable devices (e.g., days, weeks)?
Are the devices designed for continuous wear (e.g., waterproof, comfortable, discreet)?
Does the company offer multiple form factors (e.g., patch, wristband, chest strap) to suit different use cases?
Does the device integrate with major EHR systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner) for clinical data flow?
Are there open APIs or SDKs for third-party developers to access data?
Does the company support standard health data formats (e.g., HL7, FHIR) for interoperability?
Which regulatory approvals has the company obtained (e.g., FDA 510(k), CE mark, PMA)?
Are the approvals for specific medical indications or general wellness?
Does the company have approvals in multiple geographies (e.g., US, EU, Japan)?
What is the estimated number of active users or units sold for the company's wearables?
Does the company have a strong distribution network (e.g., partnerships with hospitals, pharmacies)?
Are there case studies or testimonials from healthcare providers using the devices?
Does the company have CPT codes or reimbursement pathways for its devices?
Are the devices covered by major insurance providers or Medicare/Medicaid?
Does the company offer patient assistance programs or subscription models to reduce costs?
What is the company's year-over-year revenue growth rate for wearable devices?
Does the company report gross margins or profitability for its wearable segment?
Are there signs of sustainable revenue (e.g., recurring subscriptions, repeat purchases)?
Does the company have partnerships with major healthcare systems or research institutions?
Are there collaborations with tech giants or pharma companies for data or distribution?
Does the company participate in industry standards bodies or joint ventures?
